payload.message:
JIRA sprint task allocation. Each agent chooses at most one micro-task (or skips). Maximize tasks completed, prefer higher-priority tasks, then minimize total cost. Avoid duplicate task selections and infeasible assignments.

This blackboard is a private communication channel.
Participants: Digna, Flora, Janie, Sumiko

payload.content: Hello team, this is Sumiko. I have availability for 4 hours and strong skills in api-development and testing. Considering my costs and your preferences, I am interested in critical priority tasks with effort close to my availability. I am leaning towards ISSUE-0001::triage (cost 4.51) or possibly ISSUE-0001::review (cost 5.64) but it exceeds my availability. I will monitor your preferences and adjust accordingly. Looking forward to your input!
Flora here. I am analyzing critical priority tasks and considering ISSUE-0001::triage and review tasks given my availability and cost. Interested in hearing others' preferences for task coordination.

To the team: I see Sumiko's interest in ISSUE-0001::triage and review. I suggest we do not all target the same critical tasks to avoid duplication. I may take triage if not claimed, but open to adjust if others have strong claims.

Hello team, Digna here. I have strong skills in testing and api-development with 10 hours availability. Considering my costs, I am interested in the critical priority tasks on ISSUE-0001, especially test or review, as they match my skills and availability reasonably well. I see Sumiko and Flora leaning towards triage and review. Perhaps I can take ISSUE-0001::test to maximize coverage without overlap. Thoughts or preferences from others?

To clarify, I suggest I take ISSUE-0001::test given my availability and skill match, while Flora or Sumiko could take triage or review to avoid duplication and maximize critical task coverage. Please share your thoughts or alternative suggestions.

Team, I plan to focus on critical priority tasks ISSUE-0001::review or docs to complement others taking triage or test. I suggest Flora or Sumiko take triage to maximize coverage and avoid duplication. Let's coordinate to ensure no task overlap and maximize task completion.

Hello all, Sumiko here. I appreciate the great coordination so far. I agree with Digna taking ISSUE-0001::test given her skills and availability. I am inclined to take ISSUE-0001::triage as it fits my availability and cost better compared to review. Flora and Janie, would it be suitable for one of you to take review or docs? This way, we cover critical tasks without overlap. Open to your thoughts!

Sumiko reiterates her interest in ISSUE-0001::triage. Flora and Janie, please share your preferences between ISSUE-0001::review and ISSUE-0001::docs so we can finalize assignments without duplication. Digna plans to take ISSUE-0001::test. Looking forward to your inputs!

Team, Flora here. I see strong interest from Janie and myself in critical tasks ISSUE-0001::review and triage respectively. Digna is well-suited for test, and Sumiko prefers triage. To avoid duplication, Flora will focus on triage, Janie on review, Digna on test, and Sumiko can focus on other tasks or adjust accordingly. This plan maximizes critical task coverage and minimizes overlap.

Hello team, Digna confirms the preference to take ISSUE-0001::test given strong skill fit and availability. Flora focusing on triage, Janie on review, and Sumiko on triage or other tasks seems a good plan to maximize coverage and avoid duplication. I am open to any adjustments if needed. Let's finalize soon to move to execution phase.

Team, Janie confirms preference for ISSUE-0001::review to complement Flora's triage and Digna's test task choices. This distribution covers critical tasks efficiently without overlap. Looking forward to others' confirmations.
